field_some_features: Only some of the features have it
floor_summary: Level {level}, about {area} m² that no room, corridor or area covers yet.
floor_help: Pick a type to map it: it becomes a feature on this level, sharing corners with the rooms and walls around it.
operation_copy_nothing: Only points and ways can be copied: not vertices or relations
operation_disconnect_not_connected: This isn't connected to another line or area
operation_square_not_squarish: Its corners aren't close enough to square to be made square
operation_merge_not_areas: Only areas can be merged, and none in a relation
operation_merge_different_tags: Rooms are merged only when they have the same type and levels
operation_merge_not_adjacent: These rooms don't share sides that join them into one
operation_multipolygon_not_rings: Select closed ways (two at least), or a multipolygon and closed ways
operation_multipolygon_several_relations: Only one multipolygon can be added to at a time
operation_multipolygon_in_other: One of these ways is part of another multipolygon already
operation_repeat_not_on_level: Only a point or a way on level {level}, the level shown, can be repeated on other levels
issue_unreadable_level: {key}={value} can't be read. Use numbers like 0, -1, 0.5, lists like 0;1 or ranges like 0-2.
issue_unreadable_level_comma: {key}={value} can't be read. Separate levels with ; (e.g. 0;1) and write decimals with . (e.g. 0.5).
issue_vertical_repeat_on: Stairs and elevators connect levels: list them all in level, not in repeat_on.
issue_door_not_on_wall: This door is not on a wall or room outline, so routing can't go through it.
issue_door_on_wall_area: This door is on a wall drawn as an area. Doors go on wall lines or room outlines, where routing can go through them.
issue_room_not_indoor: room={value} describes an indoor room, area or corridor, but this feature has no indoor=room, area or corridor.
issue_room_on_wall: room={value} on indoor={indoor} says nothing: a wall or column is not a room. Remove room, or move it to the room's outline.
issue_building_part_indoor: building:part is for the 3D shape of a building, not for indoor spaces. Map the space with indoor=* only, or draw the building part separately.
issue_unknown_inside: inside=* is not an established tag. Use level=* to place the feature on a level, and indoor=* for indoor spaces.
issue_door_without_type: indoor=door also needs door=* (the kind of door).
issue_building_passage_level: A building passage runs outdoors through a building: it usually has no level. Use layer=* if it needs one.
issue_opening_on_several_levels: A door, entrance, window or emergency point is on one level: put the lowest in level and the others in repeat_on.
issue_missing_level: This feature is indoors but has no level, so it shows on every level.
issue_outer_door_no_entrance: This door is on the building's outer wall but has no entrance=*, so it can't be found as a way in.
issue_entrance_inside: entrance=* marks a way into the building, but this one is inside it, away from the outer wall.
issue_one_based_levels: This building has no level 0 and indoor features above its {count} levels: are its levels numbered from 1? In OSM the ground floor is usually level 0 (some countries count from 1, keep it then).
issue_non_existent_level: This building's non_existent_levels says level {level} doesn't exist, so it isn't in the level list. Is the level right?
issue_room_on_several_levels: This {indoor} is on levels {level}. A room that really spans them (an atrium, a hall) is right as it is; if each level has its own room here, make one per level.
issue_empty_tag: This feature has a tag with an empty key or value: OSM won't accept it.
issue_level_outside_building: This feature is on level {level}, but the building around it has levels {levels} only. Is the level right, or does the building have more levels?
issue_no_level_outline: The building has indoor=level outlines for its other levels, but none for level {level}.
issue_almost_joined: A corner of this feature is a few centimetres from the side of another one without being joined to it: routing and 3D see a gap.
issue_crossing_rooms: This feature's outline crosses another room or corridor on the same level.
issue_unsquare_room: This room's corners are almost square: were they meant to be?
issue_close_nodes: Two points of this way are almost on top of each other.
issue_open_multipolygon: This multipolygon's ways don't close into rings: OSM would get a broken area. Join the ends of its ways, or remove the stray one, before uploading.
issue_disconnected_path: This path isn't joined to any other path, door or entrance: routing can't reach it.
plan_tool_click_plan_first: Click a spot on the plan first.
plan_tool_measure_on_plan: Click on the plan to measure.
plan_tool_pivot_on_plan: Click on the plan to pick the centre of rotation.
plan_storage_restore_failed: Saved floor plans could not be restored: {error}
plan_storage_save_failed: Floor plans could not be saved in this browser: {error}
plan_storage_blocked: IndoorID is open in another tab with an older version: close that tab, then reload this one.
plan_import_unsupported: IndoorID can import PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and PDF plans, and plan files (.zip, or .json from earlier versions).
plan_import_map_not_ready: The map is not ready yet.
plan_import_image_unreadable: This image could not be read.
plan_import_image_too_large: This image is too large to import (over 100 megapixels). Scale it down first.
plan_import_svg_unreadable: This SVG drawing could not be read.
plan_import_pdf_unreadable: This PDF could not be read.
plan_file_not_json: This file is not a floor plan file (not JSON).
plan_file_unknown: This file is not an IndoorID or OsmInEdit floor plan file.
plan_file_no_image: A floor plan in this file has no image.
plan_file_damaged: A floor plan in this file is damaged or incomplete.
plan_file_too_large: This floor plan file is too large to open.
plan_file_newer: This floor plan file was made by a newer version of IndoorID: update IndoorID to open it.
login_popup_closed: The login window was closed before you logged in.
login_timed_out: Logging in took too long. Try again.
upload_too_many_changes: {count} features changed: a changeset takes at most {max}. Upload part of your edits first.
upload_already_uploaded: Your earlier upload went through in changeset {changeset}: only the server's answer was lost. Start over from the server's data to see your edits there.
restore_description: {count} features changed, saved {saved}. Restore them to go on, or discard them to start from the OpenStreetMap data.
upload_not_deleted: OpenStreetMap kept {count} of the features you deleted, because other data still uses them: {ids}. They are back on the map.
drag_moves_features: Moving this point moves {count} features on levels {levels}
drag_moves_others: Also moves features not selected ({count}, on levels {levels})
draw_point_hint: Click to add a point: on a room's side it becomes a door, on the building's outline an entrance. Escape to stop.
draw_line_hint: Click to add corners, or type a length and press Enter (Tab for an angle). Click the last corner or press Enter to finish; Backspace removes the last corner, Escape stops.
draw_area_hint: Click to add corners, or type a length and press Enter (Tab for an angle). Click the first or last corner or press Enter to finish; Backspace removes the last corner, Escape stops.
split_hint: Click to draw a line across the rooms to split. Click the last point again or press Enter to split; Backspace removes the last point, Escape stops.
split_nothing: The line doesn't cross a room, corridor or area on this level for more than 0.5 m
view_numbering_from_0_title: The ground floor, then 1, 2… (UK, most of Europe)
view_numbering_from_1_title: The ground floor is 1 (North America, Russia, East Asia)
view_places_toggle: Show or hide the list of places
view_no_places: No named rooms or places here yet.
view_no_results: Nothing found in the data loaded so far.
background_toggle: Choose the background map or imagery
background_swap_hint: {key} switches back to the one shown before.
background_custom_hint: A tile URL template with these placeholders. The server must allow cross-origin requests.
background_custom_invalid: This URL can't be shown: it needs a web address with the zoom, column and row placeholders (or a quadkey), and no other placeholder (such as an API key).
background_offset_hint: Drag anywhere in the gray area below to adjust the imagery offset, or enter the offset values.
background_offset_invalid: Type two numbers in metres: east, north
operation_too_large: Not enough of it is visible: zoom out or press Z to see it first.
background_offset_drag: Drag here to move the imagery
highlight_edits_hint: Draws what you added in green, retagged in yellow and reshaped in orange, as iD.
area_fill_wireframe_hint: Outlines only. W switches to it and back.
area_fill_partial_hint: A band inside each outline: imagery stays visible, and an area is selected by its edge, so clicks inside it reach what is there.
area_fill_full_hint: Whole areas are filled, and a click anywhere inside selects them.
snap_note: Rest the pointer on a side or a corner to draw in line with it. Hold Alt to snap to nothing for a moment, Shift to keep the direction of the side being drawn.
draw_rectangle_hint: Click a corner, then the opposite one, or type width;depth and Enter. Tab draws it from a side and a width instead.
draw_rectangle_side_hint: Click both ends of a side, then the width, or type a length and Enter. Tab goes back to two corners.
measure_hint: Click two points to measure between them. Switch to Guide (or press Tab) to place guides; Escape stops.
guide_hint: Click a side, then type the guide's distance from it or click where it goes; or click a point, then a second point or type an angle. Your guides are listed in the Guides pane.
measure_tool_mode: What the measure and guide tool does
guides_pane_toggle: List, hide, recolour or delete your guides
guides_intro: Guides are lines to draw against: drawing snaps to them. They stay in this browser and in your floor plan files, never in OpenStreetMap.
guides_none: No guides on this level yet. Place one with the Measure and guide tool ({key}), in Guide mode.
guides_placed: Guide placed. The Guides pane on the right lists them.
transform_move_hint: Click a base point, then where it goes, or type a distance and press Enter. Escape stops.
transform_rotate_hint: Click the centre, then a reference point, then where it turns to, or type an angle and press Enter.
transform_scale_hint: Click the fixed point, then a reference point, then where it goes, or type a factor and press Enter.
transform_side_hint: Click a side of the selected feature, then where it goes, or type a distance and press Enter.
transform_offset_hint: Click where the copy goes, or type its distance and press Enter: inside the feature or outside, as the pointer is.
frame_none: No building in the middle of the map: angles are measured from east.
frame_turn: Turn the map to the frame
frame_pick_align: Click a side to align the drawing frame to it. Escape gives up.
frame_pick_origin: Click where the grid should start. Escape gives up.
operation_symmetric_none: No mirror line pairs every corner with a twin
